title: Quantum correlation tests at cosmic distances
summary: It is commonly accepted that the results of measurements simultaneously realized over two entangled subsystems are statistically correlated instantaneously regardless of the distance between them. In accordance with Bell theorem, everything happens in such measurements as if there was a correlation propagating at infinite speed between the two subsystems.These correlations have been so far verified experimentally up to a distance of 1200 km.
